functions.name: _buildFixture
_buildFixture
functions.natspec:
@notice Full-set fixture builder honoring metadata mode (adds SCRIPT_SOURCE,
         DEPENDENCY_SOURCE, REFERENCE_RENDER for ONCHAIN/HYBRID).

functions.name: _assembleComponents
functions.natspec:
@notice Assembles the full mandatory component set for the fixture's mode, plus the
         sanction/declaration slot.

functions.name: _scheduleAndOpen
functions.natspec: @notice Schedules the terminal freeze for a fixture and warps into the open window.

functions.name: _executeFixture
functions.natspec: @notice Runs the full staged path and executes finality for the fixture.

functions.name: _recomputeFixtureHashes
functions.natspec: @notice Rebinds the staged hash and sanction response after fixture mutation.

definition.name: FinalityTestBase
definition.natspec:
@notice Shared harness for the artwork finality registry tests: deploys the registry and
         its consumer-seam mocks and builds spec-conformant happy-path fixtures per scope.
